Our Aircond Service Vision & Mission

Our Aircond Service Vision

To be the air-conditioning company people in Kuala Lumpur call first — known less for how loudly we advertise than for the fact that what we fix stays fixed.

Our Aircond Service Mission

Our journey

How Our Aircond Business Grew in Kuala Lumpur

No overnight story — just work that led to the next job.

  1. Where our aircond work started

    Ad Aircond Solution began the way most trades do — one technician, a van, and the units in the neighbourhood around Titiwangsa Central.

  2. How word spread across KL

    Repeat calls turned into referrals. Households that had been told to replace a unit found it could be repaired, and told their neighbours.

  3. From home aircond to business premises

    Offices, shops and other business premises came next, where a unit going down costs trading hours and the work has to fit around opening times.

  4. Our aircond service today

    A workshop at Titiwangsa Central, a team working across Kuala Lumpur, and the same rule we started with: look at the unit before recommending anything.

What we handle

Aircond Brands & Models We Service

The equipment changes from job to job. The way we approach it does not.

Every aircond model and brand

Wall-mounted splits, ceiling cassettes and outdoor condensers — Daikin, Panasonic, Mitsubishi Electric, LG, Samsung, York, Midea and the rest. Tell us the make and model and we will confirm before booking.

Trained aircond technicians

The people who arrive work on these systems daily. They are trained on the equipment they are sent to, not handed a job they have never seen.

Safe aircond electrical work

Capacitors, wiring and control boards are the part of an air conditioner where guessing is both expensive and dangerous. That work is traced to the component and handled properly.

Aircond visits around your hours

Households get a time that suits them. Business premises get a visit that fits around trading hours, because a shop cannot close for an aircond.

How We Approach Every Aircond Job

Every job starts with looking at the unit. A room that is not getting cold can point to a dirty coil, a blocked drain, a low refrigerant charge, a failing capacitor or a control fault, and the only way to know which is to inspect rather than assume.

What we find gets explained in plain terms — what is wrong, what fixing it involves, and what it will take. If a repair is not worth doing on an old unit, we will say so.

The work itself gets the same care as the diagnosis: the unit is left working properly, and the room is left as we found it.

What to expect from our aircond service

  • The unit inspected before anything is quoted
  • The fault explained in plain language
  • Parts matched to your system
  • Work carried out at the agreed time
  • The space left clean afterwards
  • A straight answer when a repair is not worth it
